# Polymux

> Polymux is a native SwiftUI app for conversations with AI agents, backed by a Go agent server.

Current native source targets macOS 27 and iOS 27. It includes individual and group conversations, attachments, message search, agent profiles and avatars, and voice settings. The server runs agents, stores history and conversation-scoped memory, and connects tools.

The native app is distinct from earlier Electron releases for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Website desktop download buttons select the Electron release line. Native source version 0.4.0 does not establish signed installer availability. The native app does not expose the older Hub, Drive, Browser, Tasks, Providers, Models, or Memory settings/workspace pages.

## Current guides

- [Introduction](https://polymux.com/docs/): Native app scope and app/server boundaries.
- [Installation](https://polymux.com/docs/installation/): Native targets, older downloads, and source builds.
- [Quickstart](https://polymux.com/docs/quickstart/): Connect a configured server and start a conversation.
- [Conversations](https://polymux.com/docs/workspace/): Chats, groups, attachments, search, and profiles.
- [Models and agents](https://polymux.com/docs/models-and-agents/): Server text-model configuration versus native profiles and voice settings.
- [Memory](https://polymux.com/docs/memory/): Agent-and-conversation-scoped SQLite memory on the server.
- [Skills and MCP](https://polymux.com/docs/skills-and-mcp/): Trusted per-agent server integrations.
- [Schedules and tasks](https://polymux.com/docs/schedules-and-tasks/): Routines, background reviews, and bounded child tasks.
- [Privacy and permissions](https://polymux.com/docs/privacy-and-permissions/): App cache, remote server data, models, tools, and system permissions.
- [Troubleshooting](https://polymux.com/docs/troubleshooting/): Connection and runtime failures, including older-interface differences.

- [Blog](https://polymux.com/blog/): Dated articles may describe the earlier Electron app.
